{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Sebiri]] '''headman''' ruled a [[Sebiri village|village]] located in the equatorial region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Fond of gifts, especially luxury food, he dealt with the off-wolders [[Breslin Drake]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] known as [[the Wraith]] when they came to his planet.
